caption: A speaker on the floor of a room plays a deep bass note, and a lit candle on the same floor flickers in time with the beats.

sa.check: A speaker stands on the floor of a room.
A lit candle stands on the same floor.
The flicker comes in repeated pulses rather than one continuous waver.

pc.expect: The flame stays on the wick and points up between pulses; each flicker is a bend or shiver of the flame.
pc.fail: The flame detaches and floats away; or lies flat along the floor and stays so; or the candle slides across the floor without any tremble.

pc.expect: The flame flickers while the cone pumps and burns steady when the cone is still.
pc.fail: The cone pumps and the flame burns without a stir; or the flame flickers hard while the cone is plainly still; or the flame goes on flickering unchanged after the cone has stopped.
pc.precondition: The speaker's cone is in view.

pc.expect: At rest the flame points up and any wax drips run down the candle.
pc.fail: The flame points downward or sideways when at rest; or wax runs up the candle; or the candle rises off the floor.

pc.expect: The candle body stays rigid and the flame stays a flame.
pc.fail: The candle bends like rubber; or the flame turns into a solid glowing ball; or the wick stretches longer.

pc.expect: One candle with one flame, one speaker; nothing passes into the floor.
pc.fail: A second flame appears on the same wick; or the candle vanishes; or the speaker duplicates; or the candle sinks into the floor.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The candle's colour, the speaker's shape and the floor pattern stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or the speaker changes shape; or the floor pattern shifts.
